motivation.description: The underlying reason the resident left (e.g., financial, dissatisfaction, level of care)

reason.description: The discharge destination (e.g., skilled nursing, other assisted living). Despite its name, this field represents where the resident moved to, not why they left.

caregroveResidentId.description: The person's resident ID in CareGrove

eldermarkResidentId.description: The person's resident ID in Eldermark

realpageResidentId.description: The person's resident ID in RealPage

welcomeHomeResidentId.description: The person's resident ID in WelcomeHome

yardiResidentId.description: The person's resident ID in Yardi

bed.description: The bed the resident will move to

occupancyType.description: Whether the destination bed is private or shared

room.description: The room the resident will move to
